items.source:
Allows to use standard XML entities to include XML snippets into an
application context definition, for example to split a large XML file
into various modules. The include paths can be relative to the
application context's resource base as usual, instead of relative
to the JVM working directory (the XML parser's default).
items.translation: 允许使用标准 XML 实体将 XML 片段包含到应用程序上下文定义中，例如将大型 XML 文件拆分为各个模块。包含路径可以像往常一样相对于应用程序上下文的资源基础路径，而不是相对于 JVM 工作目录（XML 解析器的默认值）。

items.source:
Note: In addition to relative paths, every URL that specifies a
file in the current system root, i.e. the JVM working directory,
will be interpreted relative to the application context too.
items.translation: 注意：除了相对路径之外，任何指定当前系统根目录（即 JVM 工作目录）中的文件的 URL，也将相对于应用程序上下文进行解释。

items.source: Subclasses can override this method to change the default behavior.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以更改默认行为。

items.source: A fallback method for resolveEntity(String, String) that is used when a "schema" entity (DTD or XSD) cannot be resolved as a local resource.
items.translation: 用于在无法将“模式”实体（DTD 或 XSD）解析为本地资源时，作为 `resolveEntity(String, String)` 的备用方法。

items.source:
Create a ResourceEntityResolver for the specified ResourceLoader
(usually, an ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 为指定的资源加载器（通常是 ApplicationContext）创建一个 ResourceEntityResolver。

items.source: Return null to fall back to the parser's default behavior.
items.translation: 返回 `null` 以回退到解析器的默认行为。

items.source: resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader (or ApplicationContext) to load XML entity includes with
items.translation: resourceLoader - 用于加载 XML 实体包含的 ResourceLoader（或 ApplicationContext）

items.source: publicId - the public identifier of the external entity being referenced, or null if none was supplied
items.translation: publicId - 被引用的外部实体的公共标识符，如果未提供则为 null。

items.source: systemId - the system identifier of the external entity being referenced, representing the URL of the DTD or XSD
items.translation: systemId - 被引用的外部实体的系统标识符，代表 DTD 或 XSD 的 URL。

items.source: Throw an exception to prevent remote resolution of the DTD or XSD.
items.translation: 抛出异常以防止远程解析 DTD 或 XSD。

items.source:
an InputSource object describing the new input source, or null to request
that the parser open a regular URI connection to the system identifier
items.translation: 描述新输入源的 InputSource 对象，或为请求解析器向系统标识符打开常规 URI 连接而设为 null。

items.source: resolveEntity in interface EntityResolver
items.translation: `resolveEntity` 接口 `EntityResolver`
